reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay, the single predicate every holiday check in shared/schedules, schedules app and budget template already calls.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the MM-DD match is a one-line addition inside the shared predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts where the non-working-day rule is defined, with the format documented on the RecurConfig type.

scope.why: Predicate change, type doc comment, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, documented change at the one place that owns the rule; all callers inherit it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay.
